name: git-hygiene
description: Tells you which branches are proved safe to delete, keeps project worktrees in one configured folder, and cleans up finished worktrees. It removes only the branches and worktrees you approve, re-checks each one first, and keeps anything it cannot prove safe.

interface.shortDescription: Which branches and worktrees are proved safe to clean up
interface.longDescription: Branches pile up and nothing tells you which ones matter. Git Hygiene separates age from deletion evidence. It shows branches proved safe by reachability or independent merge or content evidence, and keeps everything else as not proved safe without claiming the work exists nowhere else. It deletes only after approval, re-checks each branch immediately before deletion, and uses a separate confirmed force step only when a locally verified branch is safe but lowercase git branch -d refuses it. Anything it cannot classify is kept and the reason is shown. With an optional setting, it blocks misplaced project worktrees and points to the folder to use. It also audits linked worktrees, says at session start when one sits outside that folder, and moves or removes an exact worktree only after approval and an immediate re-check. Removing a worktree never deletes its branch.
